newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds fell $3.91 billion to $587.36 billion in the week ended Sept. 18, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 407 taxable money market funds in the retail category fell $2.70 billion to $478.40 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds fell $1.20 billion to $108.95 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 306 institutional money market funds rose $2.16 billion to $273.54 billion. Of these, the 244 taxable money market fund assets grew $3.19 billion to $245.06 billion, and assets of the 62 tax exempt funds fell $1.04 billion to $28.50 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $860.90 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended September 11 were revised to $862.65 billion from $861.54 billion.
